description: This is a React component named 'EmojiManager' that allows administrators to manage emojis within an application. It supports adding Unicode emojis, uploading image-based emojis, displaying a grid of current emojis with usage stats, and removing emojis with confirmation modals. The component interacts with external API services for CRUD operations.

methods.name: normalizeList
methods.description: Normalizes raw list of emojis (strings or objects) into a unified object structure with 'text' or 'image' kind.

methods.name: seedCount
methods.description: Generates a deterministic-ish usage count for an emoji entry, based on its identity.

methods.name: ensureCounts
methods.description: Ensures that the usage counts include all current emojis, initializing new entries and cleaning up removed ones.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the latest emojis list from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new Unicode emoji to the list.

methods.name: onConfirmRemove
methods.description: Handles removing the selected emoji after user confirmation.

methods.name: onUpload
methods.description: Handles uploading a new image-based emoji.

methods.name: openConfirmFor
methods.description: Opens the confirmation modal for a given emoji entry.
